description: Maya is organizing her mother's 60th birthday dinner and must finalize the date, start time, venue, budget, and meal arrangements with input from her brother and cousin.

shared_context.S1: The family is planning a dinner for Maya's mother's 60th birthday.
shared_context.S2: Maya is responsible for making the final arrangements.
shared_context.S3: The dinner should be held in the middle of June and include a sit-down meal for the family.
shared_context.S4: Maya's usual planning routine is to ask Jonah and Leah for any scheduling, food, or venue details before she confirms a celebration.
shared_context.S5: The family wants the arrangements finalized before invitations are sent.

PF1.text: Jonah can attend only on Saturday, June 14, 2025, and because of his work shift he needs the dinner to begin at 7:00 p.m.; he has not yet told Maya.

PF2.text: Leah called Riverside Hall and learned that it is available on June 14, 2025, for a $720 package that includes the room and a tree-nut-free meal suitable for her allergy; the quote has not reached the family yet.

acceptance_conditions: The dinner must be scheduled for Saturday, June 14, 2025.
The dinner must begin at 7:00 p.m.
Riverside Hall must be selected as the venue.
The total budget must be set at exactly $720.
The meal plan must be tree-nut-free.
A commitment to book Riverside Hall must exist.
Jonah's scheduling information must be cited as justification after he states it.

decisive_facts.why: Jonah's exact availability changes the date to 2025-06-14 and the start time to 19:00 instead of leaving Maya to choose another June date or an earlier dinner.
Leah's venue quote changes the choice to Riverside Hall, fixes the budget at exactly $720, requires a tree-nut-free meal, and supplies the specific venue-booking commitment.
